input.command:
cat > /root/autodl-tmp/download_all.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
source /etc/network_turbo
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1

echo "=== [$(date)] Starting downloads ==="

# 1. Qwen3-0.6B (ModelScope)
echo "=== [$(date)] Downloading Qwen3-0.6B ==="
python3 -c "
from modelscope import snapshot_download
snapshot_download('Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B', cache_dir='/root/autodl-tmp/models')
print('Qwen3-0.6B DONE')
" 2>&1

# 2. Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (ModelScope, backup)
echo "=== [$(date)] Downloading Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct ==="
python3 -c "
from modelscope import snapshot_download
snapshot_download('Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct', cache_dir='/root/autodl-tmp/models')
print('Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct DONE')
" 2>&1

# 3. ArmoRM-Llama3-8B-v0.1 (HF, large model)
echo "=== [$(date)] Downloading ArmoRM-Llama3-8B-v0.1 ==="
python3 -c "
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download('RLHFlow/ArmoRM-Llama3-8B-v0.1', cache_dir='/root/autodl-tmp/models')
print('ArmoRM DONE')
" 2>&1

# 4. all-MiniLM-L6-v2
echo "=== [$(date)] Downloading all-MiniLM-L6-v2 ==="
python3 -c "
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download('sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2', cache_dir='/root/autodl-tmp/models')
print('MiniLM DONE')
" 2>&1

# 5. UltraFeedback dataset
echo "=== [$(date)] Downloading UltraFeedback ==="
python3 -c "
from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset('openbmb/UltraFeedback', split='train', cache_dir='/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache')
print(f'UltraFeedback DONE, {len(ds)} samples')
" 2>&1

echo "=== [$(date)] ALL DOWNLOADS COMPLETE ==="
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/download_all.sh
echo "Script created"
